comment: Kodak VISION3 500T 5219/7219 'Spectral Sensitivity Curves' (TI2647D), p.4. Log sensitivity = log10(1 / exposure in erg/cm^2 needed for density 0.2 above D-min), Status M. Curves share one stroke; told apart by bounding box. Yellow-forming = blue-sensitive layer, magenta-forming = green, cyan-forming = red. Parts of these paths run underneath the white label boxes Kodak placed over the graph (the 'Effective Exposure' legend and the layer names); the hidden parts are kept, since they are Kodak's own plotted data, and were checked on the overlay.
